body:
@kky The fact that the default theme as very few rules is normal and on purpose. I know it looks counterintuitive but this was done to avoid any styling collision with the host website using instantsearch.js.

So we deliberately choosed to have a very RAW theme and let useres do their own theming by overriding classes.

That's why we still have all the css classes defined but empty in the unminified version: http://cdn.jsdelivr.net/instantsearch.js/1/instantsearch.css

I will try to explain this in clear words in the documentation and fix this 404.

Thanks a lot for the feedback.
